listing.name: Aero the Acro-Bat — ATA-Recomp (Ryah)
listing.summary: The project reports movement, jumping, landing and music in the first circus stage of v0.1.1. A full campaign, bosses, physical controllers and the complete soundtrack are unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA ROM, 1048576 bytes, with CRC32 A3A7A8B5 and SHA-256 6E845533D3D41DD10C7A0C7FBAE5AB1FD2669F925CC5903954FB485859234B79.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Set your own ROM path in rom.cfg and use AeroLauncher.exe. The player needs no compiler or Python. The separate Build.ps1 source route builds the game and launcher with pinned SDK patches. Portcove has not inspected the exact published release file.

warnings: The project reports movement, jumping, landing and music in the first circus stage of v0.1.1. A full campaign, bosses, physical controllers and the complete soundtrack are unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
